meta.name: Devika And Danny
meta.description:
Devika, a compassionate and grounded music teacher living a seemingly ordinary life, is engaged to an insecured and possessive Jaggu. Meanwhile, she bumps into a stranger Danny and his arrival begins to shift Devika's world, leading her down an unforeseen path of self-discovery and unexpected connections.

Complete series. On your server: S1 7/7
